prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic historical portrait of Elon Musk reimagined as a wealthy ancient Mesopotamian or Egyptian-era noble merchant standing in a sunlit riverfront city. Show him from the waist up in the foreground, centered slightly left, looking confidently off to the upper right with a calm serious expression. He wears an off-white rough linen tunic with frayed sleeves, a dark brown patterned draped shawl over one shoulder, layered bead-and-gold necklaces, and multiple engraved gold bracelets with blue stones on both wrists. His hands hold one clay tablet covered in cuneiform-like writing close to his chest. The environment is an ancient desert port city at golden hour: a carved stone pillar with hieroglyphic-style symbols on the far left, palm trees and mud-brick buildings in the background, a broad river or canal to the right with small wooden sailboats, workers carrying and stacking stone blocks, and a stepped ziggurat or pyramid-like construction site in the hazy distance with scaffolding. Use warm amber sunlight, dusty atmosphere, soft background blur, subtle rim light around the figure, realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, epic film still composition, 35mm anamorphic look, high detail, natural colors, no modern objects, no text overlay, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张电影级照片真实感的历史肖像，主角为 Elon Musk，将其重构为一位富有的古代美索不达米亚或埃及时代的贵族商人，站在阳光明媚的河畔城市中。画面展示他从腰部以上的特写，位于前景且略微偏左，神情自信且严肃，目光望向右上角。他身穿一件灰白色的粗亚麻束腰外衣，袖口磨损，肩上披着深棕色花纹披肩，佩戴多层珠饰与金项链，双腕戴着多枚镶嵌蓝色宝石的雕花金手镯。他的双手将一块刻有类似楔形文字的泥板紧贴在胸前。环境设定为黄金时刻的古代沙漠港口城市：最左侧矗立着一根刻有象形文字风格符号的石柱，背景可见棕榈树和泥砖建筑，右侧是一条宽阔的河流或运河，河上有小型木制帆船，工人们正在搬运和堆叠石块，远处的朦胧背景中可见一座阶梯式塔庙或金字塔状的建筑工地，并带有脚手架。使用温暖的琥珀色阳光、尘土飞扬的氛围、柔和的背景虚化、人物周围微妙的轮廓光、真实的皮肤纹理、浅景深、史诗级电影剧照构图、35mm 变形镜头效果、高细节、自然色彩，无现代物品，无文字叠加，无水印。
